messages.subject: Scan1 Poster Presentation Parameters
parts:
Hi! First year grad student here! 

Trying to make a poster with scan1 results on it and having an issue with troubleshooting size and resolution. The larger I make the image, the smaller the axis labels get. 

Anyone have any ideas or preferences on prepping these graphs for posters?

Thank you!

Rachel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Scan1 Poster Presentation Parameters
parts:
If you were doing something like:

  png("myplot.png", height=500, width=1000)
  plot(scan1_output, map)
  dev.off()

You could add pointsize=24 or something like that to the call to png() to make all of the text bigger.

  png("myplot.png", height=500, width=1000, pointsize=24)
  plot(scan1_output, map)
  dev.off()

But there are a lot of different approaches to controlling things. If you show a bit of your code and results, we can give further suggestions.

karl
